hero.title: Journeys that begin with you
hero.intro: We don’t just choose where you’ll go. We shape how you’ll experience the world.

intro.heading: Every journey begins with a feeling.
intro.p1: Sometimes you don’t know exactly where you want to go. But you know what you’re missing. Maybe you want to escape somewhere far away. Slow down. Discover something new. Or simply feel the excitement of travel again.
intro.p2: That’s why we don’t start with a ready-made itinerary. We start with you. Tell us how you want to travel, what inspires you, and what you don’t want to miss. We’ll create the rest.

journey.heading: Where should we begin?
journey.intro:
You don't need to have a destination in mind.
Choose what feels right for you and get inspired.

explore.title: A few ideas to get you started.
explore.subtitle: No packages. No rules. Just places where your story can begin. Can't see what you have in mind? Good. We'll create it.

why.heading: We know the world. But first, we want to get to know you.
why.ctaHeading:
Your next journey doesn't have to start with a destination.
Have a place in mind? Great. Don't? Even better.
Tell us what you're imagining. We'll create it together.

regionPage.introBody: No two countries in {region} feel the same — and no two trips here should either. We design every journey around how you want to feel, from the first idea to the moment you're home. No templates, no planning fees.
regionPage.experienceHeading: Don't know where? Start with a feeling.

destinationPage.tripsIntro:

Keep what you like. We'll create the rest around you.

experiencesPage.tripsIntro: A few journeys to spark ideas — each tailored, altered and refined until it's yours.
experiencesPage.heroTitle: Don't just choose where. Choose how.
experiencesPage.heroSub: Who you're travelling with, what moves you and how you want to feel — that's where the journey begins.
experiencesPage.introLead: The journey doesn't start with a map. It starts with what you want from it.
experiencesPage.introBody: Maybe you want time just for the two of you. Maybe you want the kids to finally forget about their screens. Maybe you're drawn to the wilderness, the sea, the food, the unknown — or simply the feeling of being far away from everyday life again.
experiencesPage.introClose: Tell us what moves you. We'll find where it takes you.
experiencesPage.howEyebrow: How do you want to travel?

tripPage.notesIntro: The key practical details for this trip, in one place.
tripPage.makeYoursBody: Every journey with Bookit is tailored precisely to who you are and what you want to do. So tell us a little more about yourself and we'll create something completely made to measure.

flightTickets.title: Getting from A to B is the easy part.
flightTickets.intro: Tell us where and when you want to travel. We'll review the options and recommend the flight that makes the most sense for your budget, timing, and way of travelling.
flightTickets.name: Your name
flightTickets.finePrint: The form sends your details straight to our team. We reply quickly.
flightTickets.sentTitle: Your request is on its way
flightTickets.sentBody: We'll send you our best offer as soon as possible.
flightTickets.subtitle:
The real question is how
to get there best.
flightTickets.channelLegend: How would you most like to talk?
flightTickets.whyLead: Because the cheapest flight isn't always the best one.
flightTickets.why1Body: We look beyond the price. We consider total travel time, connections, and how practical the entire journey is.
flightTickets.why2Body: Baggage, fare conditions, and additional costs are part of the decision, not something you should discover later.
flightTickets.why3Title: A real person when you need one
flightTickets.why3Body: When you have a question about your booking, you know exactly who to turn to.

enquiry.sentTitle: Your enquiry is on its way
enquiry.sentBody: We’ll match you with a bookit travel expert and be in touch within 24 hours to set up a time to talk — over email, phone or video, whatever suits you. In the meantime, you can reach us any time on <phone></phone>.
enquiry.title: Step 00. Say hello.
enquiry.pageIntro: You don't need a finished plan. A destination is enough. A time of year is enough. Even “I want to go somewhere far away in October” is enough. Tell us what you know so far, and one of our travel designers will take it from there.
